title: The Pelicans Broke How I Understand Pro Basketball | Defector
description: It's unlikely that you spend much time thinking about the New Orleans Pelicans. However, as a New Orleans resident for whom ball is life, I am rather fixated on them. This team is far stranger than you may have previously understood.

title: The Big 12 admitting to this mistake caps a whole Saturday of college…
description: The Big 12 admitting to this mistake caps a whole Saturday of college football officiating arguments—like whether or not Florida State deserved a touchdown at the end of their overtime loss to Miami.

title: Nobody got laid at BYU last night, but it looked like a fun party all…
description: Nobody got laid at BYU last night, but it looked like a fun party all the same. The eighth-ranked Cougars hosted the No. 2 Notre Dame Fighting Irish in the big primetime slot Saturday, and they stayed undefeated by squeaking out a 28-24 win.

title: How to Work Hard
description: It might not seem there's much to learn about how to work hard. Anyone who's been to school knows what it entails, even if they chose not to do it. There are 12 year olds who work amazingly hard.
